issues.where: the domes in the red pool, centre right and centre left
issues.what: the domes are perfect smooth shells with an even satin sheen, so they read as CG primitives or plastic. The left one is a thin, see-through half-shell with a hard rim that floats on the surface. Nothing of the pool is on them: no salt crust, no wet line, no staining
issues.fix: break up the shape and give them a salt-crusted, uneven skin with a wet, darker band at the waterline. Replace the hollow left shell with a solid form that meets the water

issues.where: the salt plates and ridges on the right side, also seen in the set-A-03 right crop
issues.what: the plates are flat slabs with stretched, smeared texture. The ridges are extruded, faceted spikes with dark pits, and white hair-like strands stick out of them. It reads as geometry, not crust
issues.fix: rebuild the crust with real thickness, rounded and crystalline edges and texture at the proper scale. Remove the strand artifacts

issues.where: top-left crop, the trunk on the left edge around x 115
issues.what: the trunk and its frond are cut off by a hard vertical line. It reads as a seam or a clipped card
issues.fix: fix the clipping or depth-of-field edge so the trunk ends naturally

issues.where: top-right crop, centre background, in the fog
issues.what: thin dark squiggled strokes look like faint handwriting or text in the mist
issues.fix: remove the stray line geometry or texture

issues.where: flying insects in the top-right crop and in set-A-09 next to the trunk
issues.what: the insects are flat grey, translucent cards with no shading or detail
issues.fix: use shaded, volumetric insect models with motion blur, or remove them from the close range

issues.where: the droplets around the fronds and between the trunks
issues.what: water drops hang in the air away from any frond. The close-up fronds look waxy and plastic, with even dots for drops (set-A-08 bottom-right crop)
issues.fix: attach the drops to the leaf surfaces and give the fronds varied, rougher material response

issues.where: bottom-right crop, the trunks standing in the pool
issues.what: every trunk shares the same ring banding and the same texture. The same repeat shows in set-A-04 and set-A-07
issues.fix: vary the trunk textures, the ring spacing and the weathering on each instance

issues.where: the left crop, the salt island
issues.what: the salt is one smeared, repeated noise with flat red holes, and its edge is a clean extruded rim
issues.fix: use higher-resolution, scale-correct salt texture with crusted, irregular edges and wetness where it meets the water

issues.where: the right crop, the foreground salt crust
issues.what: close to the camera the crust is soft, low-detail and clay-like, with no crystal structure
issues.fix: raise the texture and displacement resolution for close-range crust

issues.where: the cracked block in the left foreground and the striped pole with the red ball
issues.what: the block has an even polygon crack pattern that looks like a tiled texture on a clay-like mass. The pole is a clean cylinder with regular rings and reads as a prop
issues.fix: vary the crack scale and the depth of the block, and give the pole irregular form and weathering

issues.where: the bottom-left crop, the far shore
issues.what: the shore edge is a flat white sheet with stretched texture that looks like a tarp
issues.fix: give the shoreline crust real thickness and wet edges

issues.what: the fog is a flat, even white tint over the plants with no light structure in it
issues.fix: add variation in density and light scattering to the mist

issues.where: the mound at the right and the steam patch at centre
issues.what: the mound is smooth with no contact detail. The steam patch reads as a flat, soft card
issues.fix: add contact and crust detail to the mound and volumetric structure to the steam
